verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a Claude Code skill and plugin bundle, distributed through a plugin marketplace. Versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for such a tool, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions versioned APIs, release versioning or a deprecation policy. The only API mention (gh-2) covers planning an API for the user's clone, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
